planets.name: HD 18599 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 18599 with a 4.14-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 18599 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 18599. Its orbit and size follow Desidera et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
